name: BeamIntensityObservation
description: Particle-accelerator beam intensity observation demonstrating two temporalReferenceSystem bindings in one record. archive_time_s is an int64 UTC coordinate bound to the OGC UnixTime TemporalCRS (kind ogc-temporal-crs). beam_clock is an object carrying a non-civil accelerator run clock bound to a local meta-type (kind type); the position member of the annotation names the fixed-width ordinal member within the object. The two clocks operate independently: mapping the beam clock to UTC requires an authoritative synchronisation relation that this specification does not supply.

observation_id.description: Unique identifier for this observation record.

facility_id.description: Identifier of the accelerator facility and ring segment where the measurement was taken.

archive_time_s.description: UTC wall-clock time at which the data-acquisition system recorded this measurement, expressed as a count of SI seconds elapsed since the Unix epoch 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Bound to the OGC UnixTime TemporalCRS; the axis unit is seconds and positions sort in forward (increasing) order. This is the result time of the DAQ system, not the beam-physics phenomenon time.

beam_clock.description: Beam-physics phenomenon time expressed in accelerator run-clock coordinates. The regime is defined by the BeamClockPosition meta-type: a position is located by run, fill within a run, and revolution turn within a fill. The position member of the temporalReferenceSystem annotation maps the ordinal property of this object to the clockPosition member (referenceRole position) of BeamClockPosition. Positions within one fill sort lexically on ordinal; positions from different runs are not comparable. Mapping this clock to UTC requires an authoritative synchronisation relation; this specification does not supply one.

ordinal.description: Clock position rendered at fixed width with most-significant component first so that positions sort correctly under lexical ordering: R<run4>/F<fill4>/T<turn12>. Example: R0042/F0007/T000000012345.

run.description: Experiment run number. A new run resets fill and turn counters.

fill.description: Beam fill number within the current run. Each injection of beam into the ring begins a new fill.

turn.description: Revolution number of the beam bunch within the current fill, counted from injection.

beam_intensity.description: Beam current measured by the wall-current monitor at the beam_clock position.

BeamClockPosition.name: BeamClockPosition
BeamClockPosition.description: Meta-type for the accelerator beam run clock. A position is located by run number, fill number within the run, and revolution turn number within the fill. Stint and lap are not applicable; turn count resets at the start of each fill and run numbers are globally monotonic for the facility. Positions from different runs are not comparable under this regime alone; equal turn values in different fills or runs denote different physics instants. A string ordinal renders all three components at fixed width, most-significant first, so that positions within one fill sort correctly under lexical order without implementing this definition. Mapping any beam-clock position to civil UTC requires an authoritative synchronisation record maintained by the facility timing system; this meta-type does not supply that relation.

clockPosition.description: Components rendered at fixed width, most-significant first: R<run4>/F<fill4>/T<turn12>. Positions sort lexically within one fill; cross-fill and cross-run comparison is not defined by this meta-type.

fill.description: Beam fill number component within the run.

turn.description: Revolution turn number component within the fill.
